column3: So you made it to my \nhideout...
column4: 你到了我的\n藏身处啊...

column3: And you want one of my \ndrill parts right?
column4: 想要我的一个\n钻头零件,对吧?

column3: Well I'll make you a deal.
column4: 好吧,跟你做个交易.

column3: I'll give you your part if \nyou can beat me before I \ndrill your face off!
column4: 你要是能在我把你的脸\n钻烂前打败我,\n我就把零件给你!

column3: Are you looking for \nsomething?
column4: 你在找什么?

column3: Mmmrblmbmrrm rmblm...
column4: Mmmrblmbmrrm \nrmblm...

column3:
A Lost Megac is just 
beyond here. This is a good 
chance to show your 
fighting skill.
column4: 一只失魂 Megac 就在前面.这正是展\n示你战斗本领的好机会.

column3: It lost its soul and will \nattack you without holding \nback.
column4: 它失去了灵魂,会毫不留情地攻击你.

column3:
The more damage a megac 
has, the further he will 
be knocked away. 
Eventually he will break
into pieces.
column4: Megac 受的伤越重,被击退得就越远.\n最后它会碎成零件.

column3: Try to combine your \npunches to destroy it and \nget its part!
column4: 试着组合你的拳招击败它,拿到它的零件!

column3:
Enemies drop parts or 
Bits. Collect 64 Bits to 
recover a life. Collect 
parts to get new 
abilities!
column4: 敌人会掉落零件或 Bits.收集 64 \n个 Bits 可恢复一条命;收集零件可获\n得新能力!

column3: Check if the part is in \nyour inventory with \n'Enter'.
column4: 按"回车"打开背包,确认零件是否在\n其中.

column3: Then you can attach it \nto your chest with 'Z'!
column4: 再按"Z"把它装到躯干上!

column3: If you got your launch \npart ready, you can use \nits ability with 'up' and 'X'.
column4: 准备好发射零件后,按"上"和"X"即可使\n用它的能力.

column3: Try to get up there. \nJump, jump and launch!
column4: 试着上去吧.跳,跳,发射!

column3: You're almost there!
column4: 就快到了!

column3: Aerial attacks are very \npowerful, keep this in mind.
column4: 空中攻击非常强力,记住这一点.

column3: Just jump, hold a \ndirection and press 'Z' in \nthe air.
column4: 跳起后按住一个方向,再在空中按"Z".

column3: And to sprint, double tap \nleft or right.
column4: 冲刺则双击左或右.

column3: I, Leon, On behalf of the \nempire, apologize for the \nactions of General HB-02.
column4: 我,Leon,代表帝国,就 HB-02 \n将军的所作所为向你道歉.

column3: He has been discharged\nand exiled.
column4: 他已被革职,并流放.

column3: A friendly relation with\nneighbouring villages is \nin our best interest.
column4: 同邻近村落保持友好关系,最符合我们的利益\n.

column3: Hey, you're the new Megac\nright?
column4: 嘿,你就是新来的 Megac,对吧?

column3: Welcome to the village!
column4: 欢迎来到村子!

column3: Have you seen your house\nyet? very zwap!
column4: 你看过你的房子了吗?超 zwap!

column3: With you around, I don't\nhave to do all the boring \nchores anymore!
column4: 有你在,我再也不用干那些无聊的杂活了!

column3: Hello newborn.
column4: 你好,新生儿.

column3: I see you need some basic \nMegac training to get \naround.
column4: 看来你需要接受一些基础 Megac 训练\n,才能四处行动.

column3: Just continue this way and \nfollow instructions.
column4: 沿着这条路继续走,按指示行动.

column3: Do your best!
column4: 加油!

column3: Why is this cave so windy?!
column4: 这个洞穴怎么这么大风?!

column3: Level 2 is just ahead.
column4: 第 2 关就在前面.

column3: It... accidentally got \nblocked off when I was\nmoving dirt...
column4: 我搬土时...不小心把路堵住了...

column3: If only I had a drill\npart...
column4: 要是我有个钻头零件就好了...

column3: I know Bouldar has one, \nbut he lives past the \nelectro caves in level 1.
column4: 我知道 Bouldar 有一个,但他住在\n第 1 关电气洞穴后面.

column3: Could you do me a favor\nand ask him for me?
column4: 能帮我个忙,替我问他要来吗?

column3: Good day sir!
column4: 日安,先生!

column3: Hey there young Megac!
column4: 嘿,年轻的 Megac!

column3:
This here is your very own
house. It has been empty 
for a while, but I've fixed
it up a bit for you.
column4: 这是专属于你的房子.它空置了一阵,不过我\n替你稍微收拾过了.

column3: And if you're done looking\naround...
column4: 如果你已经逛够了...

column3:
The empire has asked the 
youngest Megac to come to
level 2 to receive a gift 
for the village.
column4: 帝国邀请最年轻的 Megac 前往第 2 关\n,领取赠给村子的礼物.

column3:
you should be honered!
You can find the entrance
on the east end of the 
village.
column4: 你应该感到荣幸!入口在村子东侧尽头.

column3: Ah.
column4: 啊.

column3: You have arrived.
column4: 你来了.

column3: This is our home, your home \nand home of our powerful \nheartcore of the wind.
column4: 这里是我们的家,也是你的家,更是我们强大\n的风之心核的家.

column3: We are but a small village\noutside the empire.
column4: 我们只是帝国外的一个小村落.

column3:
Even still, the empire
has requested the 
youngest Megac to accept 
a gift from them as a 
token of good will.
column4: 即便如此,帝国仍邀请最年轻的 Megac\n接受他们的礼物,以示善意.

column3:
This will be your first
mission. Travel to the
Lost Megaclopolis in 
level 2 and meet with the
imperial general.
column4: 这将是你的第一项任务.前往第 2 关的 \n失落的 Megac 都城,与帝\n国将军会面.

column3: But, you might want to\nexplore Ventu village a\nbit first...
column4: 不过,你最好先在 Ventu 村稍微探索\n一番...

column3: Just go up here and try\nto talk to the Megacs.
column4: 从这里往上走,试着和 Megacs 交谈\n.

column3: This is a Doro door.
column4: 这是一扇 Doro 门.

column3:
If you enter a Doro door, 
all the parts in your 
inventory are transfered 
to your collection.
column4: 进入 Doro 门后,背包里的所有零件都\n会转移到你的收藏中.

column3: So attach the parts you \nwant to keep!
column4: 所以先装上你想保留的零件!

column3: The doro door up here is\nthe way to Bouldars \nhideout.
column4: 上面的 Doro 门通往 Bouldar\n的藏身处.

column3: Remember that you can use \nyour inventory to see what \nparts you have with you.
column4: 别忘了用背包查看你随身带着哪些零件.

column3: If you find yourself lost, \njust go right!
column4: 要是迷路了,就一直往右走!

column3: You're back!
column4: 你回来了!

column3: Did you get a drill from\nBouldar? Pretty handy \nright?
column4: 从 Bouldar 那里拿到钻头了吗?挺\n好用的,对吧?

column3: Try using it in different \ndirections!\nZwap!
column4: 试试朝不同方向使用它!Zwap!

column3: Nevermind us, you've got\nto fight the cause in \nlevel 4 in the east!
column4: 别管我们了,你得去东面的第 4 关,为这场事\n业而战!

column3: You beat bouldar?! I\nguess he never gives away\na drill without a fight...
column4: 你打败 Bouldar 了?!我想他从不\n会不打一架就交出钻头...

column3: By the way...
column4: 顺便一提...

column3:
You should take a look at 
your collection, it's the 
big chest just in your 
house here.
column4: 你该看看你的收藏,就是你家里那个大箱子.

column3: ...HUUUUOOOOAAAAAAH...
column4: ...\nHUUUUOOOOAAAAAAH...

column3: What? don't look at me \nlike that.
column4: 什么?别那样看着我.

column3: It's boring to be stationed \nhere...
column4: 驻守在这里太无聊了...

column3: ...don't tell the elder \nI said that though.
column4: ...不过别告诉长老是我说的.

column3: HGNNN HUUUUUUUOOOOOAAAAA \n-AAAAAAH...
column4: HGNNN \nHUUUUUUUOOOOOAAAAA-AAAAAAH...

column3:
We've been having more and
more trouble with lost 
megacs from the outside 
lately.
column4: 最近外面的失魂 Megacs 给我们带来\n的麻烦越来越多.

column3: You should ask the empire \nfor some assistance when \nyou meet them in level 2.
column4: 你在第 2 关见到帝国时,该向他们请求一些援\n助.

column3: Some abilities can only be\nused once in the air.
column4: 有些能力在空中只能使用一次.

column3: You can use them again if\nyou touch the ground or \nif you get hit.
column4: 落地或被击中后,就能再次使用.

column3: That's my life-saving tip \nof the day!
column4: 这就是我今天的保命小贴士!

column3: I heard you got one of \nBouldar's drills.
column4: 听说你拿到了一个 Bouldar 的钻头\n.

column3: You are turning into quite\nthe rookie!
column4: 你越来越像个像样的新手了!

column3: Hey! Thanks for clearing \nthat rubble! I have been \nmeaning to get rid of that.
column4: 嘿!谢谢你清掉那些瓦砾!我早就想处理它们\n了.

column3: The door here leads to\nthe colorizer room.
column4: 这里的门通往调色室.

column3: You can change your color.\nIf you found some at \nleast.
column4: 你可以改变颜色,前提是你找到了颜色胶囊.

column3: I don't like those \nsubprograms one bit!
column4: 我一点也不喜欢那些子程序!

column3: Their color doesn't match\nthe color of our village \nat all!
column4: 它们的颜色和我们村子的颜色一点也不搭!

column3: Ventu village has been \ninvaded!
column4: Ventu 村遭到入侵!

column3:
While you were gone,
the subprograms came
in and started 
wrecking everything in
sight!
column4: 你不在时,子程序闯了进来,开始破坏眼前的\n一切!

column3: That General was crazy!
column4: 那个将军真疯狂!

column3:
Who would have thought
The heartcore of our 
village would be so
valuable?
column4: 谁能想到我们村的心核会如此珍贵?

column3: Does it have hidden\npowers?
column4: 它有隐藏的力量吗?

column3: I just came from the \nentrance to the Ancient\nTech Ruins in level 3.
column4: 我刚从第 3 关 Ancient Tech \nRuins 的入口过来.

column3:
And the doro door is 
leaking! There are all 
kinds of lost megacs just 
pouring in!
column4: 那扇 Doro 门正在泄漏!各式各样的失\n魂 Megacs 正不断涌进来!

column3: We've managed to block off\nthis part of the village.
column4: 我们设法封锁了村子的这一带.

column3: The other guards are\ntrying to fight them off.
column4: 其他守卫正在设法击退它们.

column3: I'm sorry, but we can't let \nyou through here...
column4: 抱歉,但我们不能让你从这里过去...

column3: I think the guards could \nuse your help at the doro\ndoor to level 3.
column4: 我想守卫们在通往第 3 关的 Doro 门那\n里需要你的帮助.

column3: Remember you can attack \nin four directions. In the \nair too.
column4: 记住,你能向四个方向攻击,在空中也行.

column3: Try kicking back or down\nin the air to finish \nopponents!
column4: 试试在空中向后或向下踢,来终结对手!

column3: I'm shocked General HB-02\nwould do something like\nthis...
column4: 真没想到 HB-02 将军会做出这种事.\n..

column3: The empire has dispatched\nthis ambassador to \napologize for everything.
column4: 帝国派了这位使者来为一切道歉.

column3: But I'm not so sure I can \ntrust them again so \neasily...
column4: 但我不确定自己还能这么轻易地再次相信他们\n...

column3: My fighting friend!
column4: 我的战斗伙伴!

column3: Color capsules can be\nfound almost anywhere.
column4: 几乎到处都能找到颜色胶囊.

column3: actually, I feel there \nmight even be a color\ncapsule in Ventu village.
column4: 说真的,我觉得 Ventu 村里可能也有\n一个.

column3: The subprograms are all\ncleaned up now, thanks to\nyou!
column4: 多亏了你,子程序现在全都清理干净了!

column3: We had to clear the mess,\nbut I got to keep this \nroom!
column4: 我们清理了乱七八糟的东西,不过这个房间归\n我了!

column3: Ain't it comfy?
column4: 挺舒服吧?

column3: The betrayal of that \nImperial general is bad \nenough.
column4: 那位帝国将军的背叛已经够糟了.

column3: But now we've got trouble\nwith level 3!
column4: 可现在第 3 关又出问题了!

column3: It's drafty in here!
column4: 这里漏风!

column3: And you...
column4: 还有你...

column3: You look terrible!
column4: 你看起来糟透了!

column3: I've made a special path \nfor you!
column4: 我为你开了一条特别的路!

column3:
Just go down here and 
through the village to 
level 4, the Subprogram
Deadlands.
column4: 从这里往下,穿过村子前往第 4 关--\nSubprogram \nDeadlands.

column3: You're the strongest of \nus all, I know you can \nsave the village!
column4: 你是我们之中最强的,我知道你能拯救村子!

column3: I think we shouldn't \ntrust the empire.
column4: 我觉得我们不该相信帝国.

column3: But what else can we do?
column4: 但我们还能怎么办?

column3: We can't handle another\nattack.
column4: 我们扛不住又一次攻击.

column3: Subprograms are nasty \nMegacs that are neither\nactive nor deleted.
column4: 子程序是既未激活,也未被删除的凶恶 \nMegacs.

column3: They usually stay in\nthe Subprogram Deadlands.
column4: 它们通常待在 Subprogram \nDeadlands.

column3: I wonder what made them \ngo here...
column4: 不知道是什么让它们来到这里...

column3: What do you think about\nthe proposition of this \nmessenger?
column4: 你觉得这位使者的提议怎么样?

column3: After all, you are the \nstrongest Megac of Ventu.
column4: 毕竟你是 Ventu 最强的 \nMegac.

column3:
After the brutal 
invasion of subprograms
by the Khoteps, the 
empire offers to protect
this village.
column4: Khoteps 残暴的子程序入侵之后,帝\n国愿意保护这个村庄.

column3: However, Ventu village \nis not under empire \ncontrol...
column4: 然而,Ventu 村不受帝国管辖...

column3:
So in return, we request 
the strongest fighter to 
help us battle a khotep 
in Frostbyte deep.
column4: 因此作为交换,我们要求最强的战士前往 \n霜蚀深渊,对抗一名 \nKhotep.

column3: Remember to collect as \nmany bits as you can.
column4: 记得尽量多收集 Bits.

column3: Every 64 bits gives you\nan extra life.
column4: 每 64 个 Bits 能多一条命.

column3: As levels get more \ndangerous, you will \ncertainly need them!
column4: 关卡越危险,你肯定越需要它们!

column3: My fighting friend!
column4: 我的战斗伙伴!

column3: Rumors say there is a\nflying village in the Lost\nTech Ruins!
column4: 传闻失落科技遗迹里\n有一座会飞的村庄!

column3: I don't believe them \nthough.
column4: 不过我不太相信.

column3: The Khoteps are lords\nfrom an far away\nindependent nation.
column4: Khoteps 是来自遥远独立国家的领主\n.

column3: They're in a fierce war \nwith the empire.
column4: 他们正与帝国进行激烈的战争.

column3:
It's strange you crossed
path with one of them,
Grand Khotep Scarb, in 
level 3...
column4: 奇怪的是,你在第 3 关遇上了其中一位--\nGrand Khotep \nScarb...

column3: They must be searching \nfor weapons to use.
column4: 他们一定在寻找可用的武器.

column3: I have a feeling they are\nbehind this attack too.
column4: 我感觉这次袭击也是他们在背后操纵.

column3:
It seems most of the 
guards went to the doro 
door of level 3 because of 
some trouble.
column4: 看来大多数守卫都因一些麻烦去了第 3 关的 \nDoro 门.

column3: Glad you could make it.
column4: 很高兴你来了.

column3: I'm sorry to disappoint...\nI have no gift for your \nvillage.
column4: 很抱歉让你失望...我没有给你村子的礼物\n.

column3: Ventu village does have\nsomething that I want...
column4: Ventu 村确实有我想要的东西...

column3: The heartcore.
column4: 心核.

column3: And you'll be my hostage\nwith which I make my \ndemand.
column4: 而你会成为我的人质,让我借此提出要求.

column3:
I don't want you moving 
around too much so I'll 
have to neutralize you
first.
column4: 我不希望你四处乱跑,所以得先让你失去行动\n能力.

column3: what? Who are you?
column4: 什么?你是谁?

column3: Trouble in your village?\nNone of my concern.
column4: 你们村出事了?与我无关.

column3: I kicked up some dust.
column4: 我扬起了一些尘土.

column3: And I got what I wanted, \na legendary arm part!
column4: 然后我得到了想要的,一个传说级手臂零件!

column3: It's a victory for the\nKhoteps and a loss for \nthe Valk empire.
column4: 这是 Khoteps 的胜利,也是 \nValk 帝国的败北.

column3: This shall be a good test.\nLet's see what this part \ncan do!
column4: 这会是一次不错的测试.看看这个零件能做什\n么!

column3: Wake up.
column4: 醒来.

column3: I am the heartcore. Your creator.
column4: 我是心核.你的创造者.

column3: You, my creation, are a megac. A\ndigital lifeform or simulation \ncreature you might say.
column4: 你,我的造物,是一名 Megac.可以说\n是数字生命体,或模拟生物.

column3: I have called you into existence \nto aid the village where I reside.
column4: 我召唤你来到世上,协助我所在的村庄.

column3: Two external forces will fight to \nharness my power.
column4: 两股外来势力将争夺并利用我的力量.

column3: But the megacs of this village rely \non me to survive.
column4: 但这个村的 Megacs 依靠我生存.

column3: It's your mission to protect Ventu.
column4: 你的使命是保护 Ventu.

column3: Now, it is time for you to learn.
column4: 现在,是你学习的时候了.

column3: Oi. It's me, Leon.
column4: 喂,是我,Leon.

column3: Don't go running into those \nred virus clouds, you'll \nget infected.
column4: 别冲进那些红色病毒云里,你会被感染.

column3: Unlike green virus, it can \nactually destroy you.
column4: 它不像绿色病毒,是真的会毁掉你.

column3: Me?
column4: 我?

column3: I still have some business \nhere.
column4: 我在这里还有些事情要办.

column3: Thank you so much for \ngetting rid of those pesky \nSubprograms!
column4: 太感谢你赶走那些讨厌的子程序了!

column3: We nearly had to evacuate\nVentu village!
column4: 我们差点就得撤离 Ventu 村了!

column3: A messenger is asking for\nthe strongest Megac...
column4: 有位使者正在寻找最强的 Megac...

column3: Why would the empire need\nour help?
column4: 帝国为什么需要我们帮忙?

column3: This is... zwappin' stupid.
column4: 这真是...蠢得 zwap.

column3:
The empire says they can
protect us from the 
khoteps if you help them 
out in Frostbyte Deep.
column4: 帝国说,只要你去 Frostbyte \nDeep 帮忙,他们就会保护我们免受 \nKhoteps 侵害.

column3: But that place is scary!
column4: 但那地方太可怕了!

column3: Besides, you will need\nvirus cloud immunity to \neven get there.
column4: 而且你得有病毒云免疫,才能到那里.

column3: So you are the one \nmessing with my \nSubPrograms...
column4: 所以你就是那个干扰我子程序的家伙...

column3: Grand Khotep Scarb told \nme about you, the Megac \nwho beat him.
column4: Khotep 领主 Scarb 告\n诉过我你--打败他的 Megac.

column3: The empire is after the \nheartcore of your village.
column4: 帝国盯上了你们村的心核.

column3: We have no choice but to\ntake it before they do.
column4: 我们别无选择,只能在他们得手前先夺走它.

column3: Scarb might have been \noverconfident...
column4: Scarb 也许太自负了...

column3: But you will find my \nmethods to be quite a bit \nmore effective!
column4: 但你会发现,我的手段要有效得多!

column3:
Watch yourself. The 
hallway up to level 5 is 
flooded with red virus 
clouds.
